coverage_floor_reason: A feature should be observable in at least four of five eligible time positions per training era to avoid making the primary HMM heavily dependent on feature-specific missingness; this is an explicit pragmatic robustness policy, NOT an estimator theorem. It is applied equally to all families and eras, not fitted to observed coverage.
early_close: calendar-verified scheduled early closes are valid endpoints if the last scheduled bar is observed

amihud_illiquidity.reason: Requires current valid price and positive volume; return eligibility verified separately.

bipower_variation.reason: Requires five consecutive eligible returns; bipower products require adjacent returns.

close_location.reason: Requires a valid current OHLC bar and nonzero range.

directional_efficiency.reason: Path efficiency denominator requires consecutive observed returns.

drawdown.reason: Point-in-time drawdown requires valid current close and past observed peak; historical continuity checked at verification.

jump_variation.reason: Difference between realized and bipower variation requires five consecutive returns.

lee_mykland_jumps.reason: Local volatility normalization requires 60 consecutive eligible returns; missing pairs cannot be bridged.

overnight_return.reason: Requires prior scheduled close and current scheduled open; session-based denominator.

skewness_and_kurtosis.reason: Higher moments are unstable at small sample sizes; use a full 60-return window.

variance_ratio.reason: Overlapping multi-period returns require consecutive one-minute returns.

volatility_of_volatility.reason: Nested volatility windows require a complete contiguous history.

freeze_rule: Written once before reading source data. Results do not modify this file. Any modification requires new dated amendment.
minute_denominator: all frozen TRAIN canonical minute-grid rows per era, including unavailable bars and session openings
overnight_denominator: TRAIN session transitions, excluding only the first TRAIN session with no prior TRAIN session
p90_60: 54 of 60 eligible within-session returns; diagnostic only, not interchangeable with strict estimators
source_policy: LEGACY and RAW separate; never cross provider, TRAIN/evaluation, or session boundaries for intraday returns
status: post-screening amendment; preliminary aggregate and annual coverage already observed
